644b06dcfb00cab2.description: About the Role Nestlé is seeking an Associate Manager Demand & Supply Planning (Temporary) to join their team in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. Key Responsibilities Lead the Monthly Business Planning Cycle (MBPC) to establish a consensus bottom-up demand plan for an 18-month horizon, aligning with Cluster, Category, and Channel dynamics. Utilize Sellout/IMS data to construct bottom-up consensus demand plans by category, district, and SKU, ensuring trade coverage adheres to agreed stock cover policies. 64ef5f4efe36a516.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع الريان الطبي في الرياض عن فني أشعة للانضمام إلى فريقه بدوام كامل. يتولى فني الأشعة مسؤولية تجهيز معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية، وإعداد المرضى، وتشغيل الأجهزة لاستخراج الصور الشعاعية وطباعتها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد أجهزة التصوير بالأشعة السينية لضمان جاهزيتها وسلامتها. تأمين ومراقبة مستلزمات التصوير الضرورية مثل الأفلام والأدوية. اتخاذ جميع إجراءات الوقاية الشخصية اللازمة لحماية الذات والمرضى من التعرض للأشعة. تنظيم مواعيد المرضى لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. مرافقة المرضى إلى غرفة التصوير بالأشعة وتحديد أجزاء الجسم المراد تصويرها بدقة. تحديد طبيعة الصورة الشعاعية المطلوبة ومواصفات الأشعة المناسبة لكل حالة. تثبيت ألواح من الرصاص لحماية الأجزاء الجسدية التي يجب ألا تتعرض للأشعة. توجيه وضبط أجهزة التصوير واختيار مدة وشدة التعرض للأشعة لالتقاط صور شعاعية واضحة. إظهار وتثبيت الصور الشعاعية، وتثبيت المعلومات الأساسية عليها، وتقديمها لطبيب أخصائي الأشعة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التصوير بالأشعة. القدرة على تشغيل وصيانة معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية. معرفة قوية بإجراءات السلامة والوقاية من الإشعاع. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية عالية لإدارة المواعيد والمهام. دقة واهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد التقارير وتوثيق المعلومات. مهارات تواصل فعالة للتعامل مع المرضى والزملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأشعة ضمن فريق مجمع الريان الطبي في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل متكاملة تركز على تقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

6433c2d1b4ecb5cf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المتفوقة لإعداد وتجهيز الأطعمة عن معد وجبات سريعة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد وطهي مجموعة متنوعة من الأطعمة، بما في ذلك الوجبات السريعة والشطائر والمرطبات، لضمان تقديم تجربة طعام مميزة للعملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحضير الأطعمة والوجبات للزوار وفقًا لقائمة الأطعمة المخصصة. استخدام أدوات المطبخ المختلفة مثل الشوايات والمقالي العميقة وغيرها بفعالية وأمان. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة العامة والنظافة. متابعة صيانة وإصلاح جميع المعدات المستخدمة في عمليات التحضير والتجهيز. توفير المكونات اللازمة لتحضير الوجبات وضمان توافرها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إعداد الأطعمة أو ما شابه. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة سريعة الوتيرة. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والجودة في تحضير الطعام. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق شركة المتفوقة لإعداد وتجهيز الأطعمة. يتطلب الدور العمل في بيئة مطبخ نشطة تتطلب السرعة والدقة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يمتلكون الشغف بإعداد الطعام والالتزام بالجودة على التقديم.

647d1d83f2bbd661.description: About the Role Centriq Company is seeking an HVAC Technician to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves installing, maintaining, and repairing HVAC systems. The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented and possess strong technical skills to ensure optimal system performance and customer satisfaction. Role Overview The HVAC Technician will be responsible for the complete lifecycle of air quality systems, from initial installation through ongoing maintenance and emergency repairs. This role requires a focus on customer satisfaction, safety, and comfort, guiding clients in selecting appropriate air quality systems to meet their specific needs. Key Responsibilities Install, maintain, and repair ventilation, air conditioning systems, and associated equipment. Identify potential maintenance risks on equipment to prevent future issues. Diagnose electrical and mechanical faults within HVAC systems accurately. Perform cleaning, adjustments, and repairs on systems, including warranty services. Execute emergency repairs promptly and efficiently to minimize downtime. Provide technical guidance and on-the-job training to junior staff. Maintain daily logs and comprehensive records of all maintenance functions. Ensure strict compliance with appliance standards and the Occupational Health and Safety Act. 643251fb2ca4bc3e.description: About DeceptIQ and the Role DeceptIQ is a cybersecurity project focused on developing advanced security solutions. Assess trainees' knowledge, practical skills, and operator competency. Demonstrate proper crane operating techniques and safe work practices. Provide coaching and corrective guidance to trainees. Conduct practical assessments and maintain training and competency records. Ensure training activities comply with applicable HSE and lifting safety standards. 646600039ac85c15.job_title: Building Management System Engineer (BMS)- Riyadh, KSA
646600039ac85c15.description: A specialized engineering professional responsible for designing, programming, and commissioning automated building management systems with a strong emphasis on the Niagara N4 framework. They integrate critical low-current and IoT subsystems—such as HVAC, lighting, fire alarms, and access control—using industry-standard protocols like BACnet and Modbus. By developing user-friendly graphic dashboards and automation sequences, they optimize building energy efficiency, system performance, and operational reliability. Additionally, they manage field hardware deployment, ensure cybersecurity compliance, and collaborate closely with MEP teams and subcontractors throughout project lifecycles. Design and develop BMS architecture based on project requirements. Install and configure BMS hardware and software (controllers, sensors, actuators). Program control logic and automation sequences for HVAC, lighting, and other subsystems. Test and commission BMS systems to ensure functionality and performance. Monitor and optimize energy consumption using BMS analytics. Integrate third-party systems (e.g., fire alarm, access control, elevators) via Modbus, BACnet, or SNMP. Troubleshoot and resolve faults in BMS systems and connected field devices. Conduct site surveys and system inspections for retrofit or upgrade projects. Maintain and update BMS graphics interfaces for real-time monitoring. Collaborate with MEP, HVAC, and electrical teams during project execution. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on BMS hardware and software. Support remote monitoring and system diagnostics using IoT platforms. Generate reports on energy performance, fault logs, and system alarms. Provide technical support and training to operators and end-users. Select suitable sensors, actuators, and controllers for specific applications. Verify compliance with standards such as ASHRAE, ISO, and local codes. Ensure cybersecurity best practices in BMS networks and remote access points. Manage subcontractors and vendors during BMS installation and commissioning. Document system schematics, as-built drawings, and O&M manuals. Continuously evaluate system performance and suggest improvements for efficiency and reliability. Develop and deploy control strategies using Niagara N4 framework for HVAC, lighting, and energy systems. Create custom dashboards, alarms, and trend logs within Niagara N4 for real-time system monitoring and analytics. Familiarity with BMS, ELC, ICT, IOT and other low current systems. Experience: 1-3 years using Niagara N4 framework. Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Computer Science or Mechatronics Engineering Computer Literate, AutoCAD, Advance in Excel and other Office tools. Excellent in English Language. High-Level communication skills. Ability to create big-picture software solutions. Ability to present ideas in a clean, user-friendly way. Attention to detail.

Provide creative leadership for visual storytelling, ensuring consistent luxury brand standards, editorial quality, destination authenticity, premium production values, and brand differentiation. Experience in managing budgets and optimizing resource allocation for content initiatives. Proven track record of cross-functional collaboration with marketing, PR, and commercial teams. Success Measures Increased engagement and reach of destination marketing content. Improved campaign performance across priority source markets. Stronger portfolio storytelling across each resort. 643afc28db1e6917.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that helps organizations understand their customers and take action across the entire customer lifecycle. Our platform brings together products including Social Listening, OmniServe, Survey, and AI Agent, helping enterprise organizations across the region turn customer data into better experiences and measurable business outcomes. As Lucidya continues to scale, our products are becoming more sophisticated and our customers more demanding. Design has an increasingly important role to play in making sure that complexity doesn't become the customer's problem. Why this role matters At this level, we're looking for someone who can move beyond simply executing designs and own problems from beginning to end . You'll take ambiguous customer and business problems, work with Product and Engineering to understand what we're trying to achieve, explore different approaches, and drive the design through to implementation and iteration. You'll be working on products that can involve significant amounts of data, complex workflows, AI-powered functionality, and bilingual experiences. The challenge isn't simply making these products look good — it's making them easy to understand, efficient to use, and genuinely useful for enterprise customers . You'll have meaningful independence, but you're not expected to operate alone. You'll work alongside senior designers, Product Managers, Engineers, UX researchers, and UX writers. The strongest person in this role will know when to push their own thinking, when to ask for input, and when to challenge an assumption. What You'll Do Own design problems end-to-end. You'll take ownership from understanding the problem and defining the user experience through wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity UI, handoff, implementation, and post-launch iteration. Turn ambiguity into clarity. Requirements won't always arrive perfectly defined. You'll work with Product, Engineering, Research, and stakeholders to understand the underlying problem and determine what we actually need to solve. Design for outcomes, not outputs. You'll challenge solutions that don't clearly improve the customer's experience and use research, data, and customer feedback to understand whether your designs are actually working. Partner closely with Product and Engineering. You'll be involved early rather than receiving requirements at the end of the process. You'll help shape what gets built and work through technical and product constraints without losing sight of the customer. Raise the quality of our products. You'll contribute to Lucidya's design system and help create consistency across our products while knowing when a problem requires something different. Bring customer evidence into design decisions. You'll conduct or support usability testing and lightweight research, using what you learn to validate assumptions rather than relying solely on personal opinion. Make complex products feel simple. Whether you're designing analytics, workflows, AI functionality, or customer-facing experiences, you'll look for ways to reduce cognitive load and help users get to the outcome they need faster. Design thoughtfully for our market. You'll account for Arabic and English experiences, RTL considerations, and the needs of enterprise customers across the region. Communicate your thinking clearly. You'll present work to Product, Engineering, leadership, and other stakeholders, explaining not only what you designed but why you made those decisions. Make the team better. You'll actively participate in critiques, give thoughtful feedback to other designers, and share what you've learned rather than keeping your knowledge within your own product area. Who You Are You can own a problem without needing someone to tell you every step. You know how to take an ambiguous brief, ask the right questions, break it down, and move it forward. You think like a product designer, not just a UI designer. You're interested in the customer, the business problem, the constraints, and the outcome — not simply whether the final interface looks polished. You're comfortable challenging the status quo. If you think a requirement doesn't make sense or there's a better way to solve a problem, you're willing to say so and can back your thinking with evidence. You know when to push and when to compromise. You can defend an important design decision while understanding that product development involves technical, commercial, and time constraints. You're highly collaborative. You don't throw designs over the wall to Engineering or wait for Product to tell you what to do. You work with people throughout the process. You're comfortable with ambiguity and change. Priorities may shift, requirements may evolve, and not every decision will be made for you. You stay focused on the outcome rather than becoming frustrated by the process. You're genuinely curious about users. You want to understand why customers behave the way they do and are willing to change your design when the evidence tells you that your original assumption was wrong. You communicate with clarity. You can explain complex design decisions to people who aren't designers and can adapt how you communicate depending on whether you're speaking with an Engineer, Product Manager, customer, or executive. You care about quality. You have high standards for interaction, usability, accessibility, and visual design, but you also understand when “good enough to learn” is better than spending weeks perfecting something nobody has validated. You have 3–5 years of product design or UX/UI experience , ideally in B2B or SaaS environments, with a portfolio demonstrating genuine end-to-end product thinking. You're proficient in Figma and comfortable with prototyping, design systems, and modern product design practices. You're a Saudi national , as this position is designated for Saudi nationals. Nice to Have Experience designing data-heavy or analytics-driven B2B products. Experience with AI-powered products, conversational interfaces, or AI agents. Experience designing Arabic/English or RTL experiences. Familiarity with tools such as FigJam, Maze, LogRocket, or similar research and testing tools. What the hiring process will look like Recruiter screening — An initial conversation about your experience, motivations, and what you're looking for next. Design interview — A deeper discussion with the Design team around your product thinking, design process, and approach to solving complex problems. Portfolio / case study presentation — You'll take us through selected projects, focusing on the problem, your role, decisions, trade-offs, collaboration, and measurable or observable outcomes. Team / culture interview — A conversation focused on how you work, give and receive feedback, handle disagreement, and contribute to a high-performing team. Final interview — Final conversation with the relevant leadership team.

6488a4871b4e9286.description: About Parrot Analytics Parrot Analytics is the global authority on media and entertainment intelligence, providing the strategic decision support that the world’s leading studios, producers, streamers, investors, and government bodies rely on to de-risk content investment and maximize returns. Trusted across the full media economy — from studios and streaming platforms to film funds, sports leagues, and government bodies — Parrot Analytics informs capital allocation, acquisitions, programming strategy, and IP valuation at the highest levels of the industry. By measuring the demand and preferences of more than 2 billion audiences worldwide, Parrot Analytics’ AI platform quantifies the value of content, talent, franchises, and sports rights — enabling partners to forecast revenue, assess risk, optimize portfolio strategy, and drive more predictable success. About the Role The global entertainment industry invests hundreds of billions of dollars into film and television content every year. Yet investment decisions are still largely made using fragmented market signals, limited financial modelling, and incomplete audience insight. Parrot Analytics is building a new analytical layer for the industry — combining the world’s largest dataset on global audience demand with structured financial modelling to help studios, investors, and funds make more disciplined content investment decisions. We are seeking a Senior Investment Analyst to lead the development of financial models used to evaluate film and television projects. This role sits at the intersection of entertainment economics, investment analysis, and data science, translating audience demand signals, project budgets, and distribution assumptions into structured financial forecasts and investment insights. The successful candidate will play a key role in helping investors understand the risk and return profile of content investments before capital is committed. Build Investment Models for Film & Television Projects Develop sophisticated financial models that evaluate the commercial performance of film and television projects across multiple distribution windows. Models will incorporate production budgets and cost structures, financing structures and investor positions, distribution revenue streams across global markets and investor return scenarios and capital recovery timelines. Revenue modelling will consider multiple distribution pathways including theatrical, SVOD, AVOD, FAST, Pay TV, and international licensing. Leverage Parrot Analytics’ global dataset on audience demand and content valuation to inform revenue assumptions within financial models. Develop structured approaches to translating audience demand signals and valuation into realistic commercial scenarios, benchmarking projects against comparable titles across genres, markets, and platforms. Quantify Investment Risk Evaluate projects through structured scenario modelling that assesses downside risk and capital exposure, break-even performance thresholds and investor return scenarios under different market conditions Conduct sensitivity analysis across key variables including budget changes, distribution outcomes, and shifts in audience demand. Support Investment Decision-Making Produce financial analyses used by funds, studios, and investors evaluating content opportunities. Translate complex financial models into clear insights that help decision-makers understand the economic implications of project budgets, distribution strategies, and market positioning. Develop Industry-Leading Modelling Frameworks Help design the financial modelling frameworks used to evaluate film and television investments using Parrot Analytics’ data. The goal is to build repeatable analytical tools that allow projects to be evaluated with institutional investment discipline, enabling more structured decision-making across the industry. Your experience 5–10+ years of experience in roles that require strong financial modelling and investment analysis in the following environments: film or television investment funds studio finance or content strategy teams media-focused investment banking or private equity entertainment strategy consulting corporate finance roles within media or technology companies Direct experience working with film finance structures, production budgets, or distribution economics is required. The skills you bring Advanced financial modelling - Ability to build complex Excel models from scratch incorporating scenario analysis, sensitivity modelling, and structured investment return frameworks. Investment analysis mindset - Strong ability to evaluate opportunities through structured risk and return analysis. Data-driven thinking - Comfortable integrating external datasets and quantitative signals into financial forecasts and commercial assumptions. Intellectual curiosity - A genuine interest in understanding how film and television projects generate economic value. Communication - Ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear insights for non-technical decision-makers. Ideally fluent in Arabic to service regional clients. Who Will Thrive in This Role This role is best suited to individuals who: enjoy building deep, structured financial models are naturally curious about the economics of media and entertainment think rigorously about downside risk as well as upside potential enjoy turning messy real-world information into structured analysis are excited about building new analytical frameworks for an industry Be Part of a Founding Team : Join a pivotal, early team member group supporting our newly established HQ in Qatar, with the opportunity to help shape its direction and impact from the ground up. Global & Distributed by Design : Work as part of a globally distributed team, collaborating across timezones while contributing to high-impact, international projects. Flexible Ways of Working : Operate in a flexible environment that supports autonomy while enabling seamless collaboration across teams and regions. Collaborative & Transparent Culture : Be part of a team that values openness, knowledge-sharing, and strong cross-functional collaboration. Purpose-Driven Work : Join a team of problem solvers who care deeply about delivering meaningful insights and real value to clients. Stay Connected Globally : Take part in monthly virtual all-hands sessions to celebrate wins, share updates, and stay aligned on company goals and strategy.
